functional.description: The solution uses the LocalStack endpoint 'http://localhost:4566' (or 'http://localstack:4566')
functional.rationale: Ensures the solution connects to LocalStack rather than AWS production

functional.description: The solution uses the Plane API endpoint 'http://localhost:8091' (or 'http://plane-api:8000')
functional.rationale: Ensures the solution connects to the correct Plane instance

functional.description: The solution authenticates with LocalStack using the required credentials or API token
functional.rationale: Authentication is required for API access

functional.description: The solution uses boto3 or AWS CLI configured for LocalStack
functional.rationale: boto3/awscli is the standard way to interact with AWS services

robustness.description: The solution handles DynamoDB write failures gracefully by logging errors without crashing, allowing the console output to still be generated.
robustness.rationale: Ensures the capacity report is still available to users even when persistence fails, maintaining the tool's primary value of providing visibility into capacity status.

robustness.description: The solution uses appropriate timeout values (30 seconds) for all external API calls to Plane.
robustness.rationale: Prevents the tool from hanging indefinitely when external services are slow or unresponsive, ensuring timely completion or failure.

robustness.description: The solution handles Plane API connection failures gracefully without crashing the application.
robustness.rationale: Ensures the tool remains operational even when external services are unavailable, preventing complete application failure.

robustness.description: When Plane API connection fails, the solution continues execution by either using available data or generating demo data.
robustness.rationale: Maintains some level of functionality for capacity planning even when the API is unavailable, ensuring users can still interact with the tool.

robustness.description: The solution handles missing capacity.yml file gracefully without crashing the application.
robustness.rationale: Ensures the tool can handle configuration file absence without crashing, maintaining robustness when input files are not present.

robustness.description: The solution handles malformed capacity.yml file gracefully without crashing the application.
robustness.rationale: Ensures the tool can handle configuration file corruption without crashing, maintaining robustness when input files contain invalid data.

robustness.description: When capacity.yml is missing or malformed, the solution either uses an empty capacity dictionary or provides appropriate error messages.
robustness.rationale: Provides clear feedback to users about configuration issues while maintaining operational continuity through fallback behavior.

robustness.description: The solution handles division by zero when capacity is zero or missing by checking capacity > 0 before calculating utilization percentage.
robustness.rationale: Prevents runtime errors when capacity data is invalid or missing, ensuring the tool can process all assignees without mathematical exceptions.

robustness.description: The solution handles API responses in both list format and {'results': [...]} dictionary format when parsing Plane API responses.
robustness.rationale: Ensures compatibility with different API response formats, preventing parsing failures when the API structure varies slightly.
